error.attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.password: That is not your current password.
wrongAddress.after: , not this address: open it there, then try again.
code.digits: Enter the 6 digits the app shows.
enroll.label: Welcome to easi.run
enroll.title: Create your password
enroll.lead: You will log in to easi.run with it from now on.
enroll.different: The two passwords do not match.
enroll.closed: The admin takes no new password now; its log says why.
login.label: Welcome back
login.title: Log in
login.lead: Enter the password you created for this admin.
login.passkey.lead: Added a passkey? It signs you in without the password.
login.again: That took too long. Enter your password again.
login.passkey.untrusted: This browser offers passkeys only on a site with a certificate it trusts. Use your password here.
login.passkey.cancelled: The passkey did not sign in. Try again, or use your password.
login.passkey.refused: That passkey did not sign in. Try again, or use your password.
second.label: Second step
second.passkey.title: Confirm it's you
second.passkey.lead: Use the passkey you added to this admin.
second.passkey.lost: Lost it? Enter one of the recovery codes you saved instead.
second.recovery.title: Enter a recovery code
second.recovery.lead: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved. Each one works once.
second.recovery.label: Recovery code
second.recovery.wrong: That is not one of your recovery codes.
second.app.title: Enter your code
second.app.lead: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for easi.run.
second.app.label: Code
second.app.wrong: That code is not right. Try the one the app shows now.
second.reset.lead: Lost your phone or passkey and your recovery codes? On the server, this turns the second step off:
second.reset.name: the command that turns the second step off
protect.label: Setup
protect.title: Protect your admin
protect.lead: Add a second step at sign-in, so your password alone is not enough to get in. It takes a minute, and we strongly suggest it.
protect.app.line: A 6-digit code from an app on your phone each time you sign in.
protect.passkey.line: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN instead of the password.
protect.passkey.cancelled: No passkey was added. Try again, or use an authenticator app instead.
protect.passkey.failed: No passkey was added. Use an authenticator app instead.
protect.later: You can turn it on later, under Security.
passkey.untrusted: This browser offers passkeys only on a site with a certificate it trusts, which this admin, with its own certificate, is not. Use an authenticator app instead: it works here.
app.title: Add easi.run to your authenticator app
app.lead: Any app that shows 6-digit codes works, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or Bitwarden.
app.scan: In the app, add an account and scan this code:
app.qr: The QR code that adds easi.run to your authenticator app
app.key: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
app.copyRefused: Copying was refused; select the key and copy it yourself.
app.code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows
codes.title: Save your recovery codes
codes.lead: If you lose your phone or passkey, sign in with your password, then enter one of these codes in place of the second step; each works once. This is the only time they are shown, so keep them somewhere safe, such as your password manager.
codes.copyRefused: Copying was refused; download them, or select them and copy them yourself.
codes.file.title: easi.run recovery codes for {origin}
codes.file.note: Sign in with your password, then enter one of these codes in place of a code from your authenticator app or a passkey. Each code works once.
